sudoku.scope: Complete remaining puzzle-orbit census with exactly 4 through 10 clues and one solution; one seeded random spatial/digit presentation per orbit. Not uniform over physical puzzles, not all presentations.
sudoku.census_method: Enumerate all complete Sudoku4 grids, reduce complete grids under the declared group, enumerate every clue subset of each representative and retain unique-completion puzzles.
sudoku.group: 128 legal spatial maps times 24 digit permutations; input-only keys
sudoku.exclusions: Union of every split in retained M14 original/source, M15, accepted M16 and executed M17 manifests, including previously consumed confirmation; reconstruct and verify exact input/target records before computing input-only keys.

maze.generator: Existing generate_pair with its unchanged DFS generator and no augmentation
maze.exclusions: Every split of the frozen M17 maze manifest; reject duplicate input orbits both against that ancestry and within this new sample.
maze.group: square D4 times endpoint exchange; geometric equivalence only, not arbitrary graph isomorphism
maze.core_binding: Exact frozen M17 archive, original core hashes and training manifest; no retraining

measurement.complete_solve_window: Include transformations, embedding, resets, all recursive cycles, decoding, native problem construction, validity checks, inversion and return. Independent cross-check is outside timing. Native build/load is separate.
measurement.aggregation: Median across rounds per model-example-arm; then mean and p95 of those medians
measurement.energy: Not measured; null. No transfer of earlier timing results.
measurement.hardware_scope: One recorded host; no cross-host latency claim

primary_gate_per_family.bootstrap: Crossed model-seed and unique-example resampling; 2000 replicates, seed 2026091110, percentile 95% intervals. Two maze seeds are a limited training-variation estimate.
primary_gate_per_family.joint_gate: Both families must meet all four requirements. Report each failure without changing thresholds. All results, including low-clue and per-seed strata, are retained.

secondary_controls: Report identity_20 equal-cap tradeoff, identity_4, exact symbolic comparators, regressions and per-clue results. No equal-cycle/equal-wall-clock substitution and no novelty claim.
failure_policy: Preserve failures and original partial logs. Source fixes must be identified and must not relabel an already inspected outcome as untouched confirmation.
